description: Dashboard: progress of enrolled trails, history (trails in progress, code-ups written, upcoming events joined, likes received), forum posts and calls to action.
Editorial articles written by the community and staff.
Calendar with every event: PSP activities, webinars, masterclasses, free events. Register for events here.
Community discussions: posts, comments and likes.
The member's own learning notes (formerly Notes). Write and revisit what you learned.

Masterclasses, webinars, PSP and Base follow-up programs, Mock Interviews (System Design, Data, Live Coding, Code Challenge, AI System Engineering, screening). Includes the 'Mapa do Labirinto' companion chapter for CodeBreakers inside the PSP follow-up.
Learning trails gated by membership (free, starter, base, PSP): AI, Backend, Node.js, Data Engineering, Full Stack, Python, iOS and more. Per-course progress tracking.
Algorithm and data-structure challenges (arrays, hashing, two pointers, linked lists, trees, graphs) grouped by difficulty, with a progress bar.
Season ranking with multipliers and rewards.
The live event currently streaming. Only meaningful while a live is on and the member has permission.
The member's own profile: LinkedIn, GitHub, location, stack tags, seniority.
Account settings and language switch (English / Portuguese).
One specific learning trail, chosen from the topic (e.g. 'backend node.js', 'python', 'ai') and the member's stack tags, seniority and enrollments.
One specific program (e.g. 'mock interview PSP', 'system design masterclass'), chosen from the topic.
One specific upcoming event, chosen from the topic (the soonest event matching the theme).
